home.title: Learn to read code, not just write it.
home.lead: AI writes code faster than anyone can read it. Reading and judging code is now the skill that matters.
home.draft: This is an early draft. The questions you see are real, but there are few of them, and some parts of the site are still missing.

home.allDone: You have answered every question there is so far. You can look at any of them again.
home.step1.title: Read a short piece of code
home.step1.text: Take your time. Nothing is timed.
home.step2.title: Choose what you think it does
home.step2.text: Or say you are not sure. That is a fine answer.
home.step3.title: See why every answer is right or wrong
home.step3.text: Each wrong answer is a specific misunderstanding, explained.
home.limits: No account needed. Progress is saved in this browser only. A placement test and accounts are planned, not built yet.

about.title: About
about.p1: This is an open source project for learning to read and understand code, from beginner to advanced. AI writes code faster than people do, so the bottleneck is now understanding and reviewing it.
about.p2: Courses are short code blocks followed by multiple-choice questions. Every wrong answer maps to a named misconception and comes with its own explanation.
about.limits.title: Honest limits
about.limits.1: This is an early draft. There are few questions, and they are still being reviewed.
about.limits.2: Progress is saved only in this browser. There are no accounts yet.
about.limits.3: A question's code is checked by running it, but whether a question teaches well is a human judgement, and we can be wrong.
about.privacy.title: Privacy
about.privacy.text: This site does not use cookies, analytics or third-party services. Your answers stay in your browser's local storage.
about.license.title: Licenses
about.license.text: The platform is AGPL-3.0, the question schema and validator are MIT, and questions are CC BY-SA 4.0.
